prompts.text: The Eiffel Tower is 330 m tall. Is the Statue of Liberty higher or lower?

Is the average human body temperature higher or lower than 38°C?
Is the average distance from Earth to Mars higher or lower than 150 million km?
Is a day on Venus (243 Earth days) higher or lower than 200 Earth days?
Is the number of bones in an adult human higher or lower than in a newborn (300)?
Is the top speed of a Formula 1 car higher or lower than 300 km/h?
Is the resting heart rate of an adult higher or lower than 100 bpm?
Is the number of letters in 'supercalifragilisticexpialidocious' higher or lower than 30?
Is the number of continents higher or lower than 5?
Is the number of teeth in an adult human mouth higher or lower than 36?
Is the number of cards in a standard deck higher or lower than 50?
Is the number of seconds in a day higher or lower than 80,000?
Is the population of the United States higher or lower than 500 million?
Is the height of the Great Pyramid of Giza higher or lower than 200 m?
